decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical MagicDrv interface and compressed volume structures.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
BIOS SYSPRE and SYSCONF and COMMAND CRATIO and TSPC include magicdrv.inc.
SYSPRE and CRATIO use multMagicdrv and driver version or mapping function codes; CRATIO also uses compressed-volume structure fields.
Prior CRATIO comparison matched 663 non-relocation bytes and 9 internal branches at its inferred target location (review 121).

Prior SYSPRE comparison classified remaining differences as the separate internal revision constant and generated-message placement (review 041); revision constant was subsequently restored in review 189.
limitations: The CRATIO range is inferred, relocation fields remain unresolved, and no separate DoubleSpace driver is reconstructed or validated. Final core links and whole-file identity remain unverified.
